00072 template<class SmartPointerType>
00073 class SmartPointerContainer
00074 {
00075 public:
00076  SmartPointerContainer(SmartPointerType* internalToUse = 0) throw() 
00077  : internal(internalToUse)
00078  {
00079  }
00080  
00081  ~SmartPointerContainer()
00082  {
00083   if(internal != 0) 
00084    internal->decrementRefCount();
00085   
00086   internal = 0;
00087  }
00088  
00089  inline SmartPointerType* getInternal() throw() 
00090  {
00091   return internal;
00092  }
00093  
00094  inline SmartPointerType* operator-> () throw() 
00095  {
00096   return internal;
00097  }
00098  
00099  inline const SmartPointerType* getInternal() const throw() 
00100  {
00101   return internal;
00102  }
00103  
00104  inline const SmartPointerType* operator-> () const throw() 
00105  {
00106   return internal;
00107  }
00108  
00109  bool isNull() const throw()
00110  {
00111   return internal == 0;
00112  }
00113  
00114  bool isNotNull() const throw()
00115  {
00116   return internal != 0;
00117  }
00118  
00119  void setInternal(SmartPointerType* newInternal) throw()
00120  {
00121   if(internal != 0)
00122    internal->decrementRefCount();
00123   
00124   internal = newInternal;
00125  }
00126  
00127  SmartPointerContainer(SmartPointerContainer const& copy) throw()
00128  : internal(copy.internal)
00129  {
00130   if(internal != 0) internal->incrementRefCount();
00131  }
00132   
00133  SmartPointerContainer& operator= (SmartPointerContainer const& other) throw()
00134  {
00135   if (this != &other)
00136   {  
00137    if(other.internal != 0)
00138     other.internal->incrementRefCount();
00139    
00140    if(internal != 0)
00141     internal->decrementRefCount();
00142    
00143    internal = other.internal;
00144   }
00145   
00146   return *this;  
00147  }
00148  
00149  bool operator== (SmartPointerContainer const& other) const throw()
00150  {
00151   return internal == other.internal;
00152  }
00153  
00154  bool operator!= (SmartPointerContainer const& other) const throw()
00155  {
00156   return internal != other.internal;
00157  }
00158  
00159 private:
00160  SmartPointerType* internal;
00161 };

00204    return;

00221  {
00222   if(index < 0 || index >= size_)

00224    ugen_assertfalse;

00226   }
00227

00231  inline const SmartPointerType* getInternal(const int index = 0) const throw() 
00232  {

00241

00243  {
00244   if(index < 0 || index >= size_) { ugen_assertfalse; return; }
00245     
00246   SmartPointerType* oldInternal = internals[index];
00247   
00248   if(oldInternal != 0)
00249    oldInternal->decrementRefCount();
00250   
00251   internals[index] = newInternal;
00252  }
00253  
00254  SmartPointerArrayContainer(SmartPointerArrayContainer const& copy) throw()
00255  : size_(copy.size_),
00256   internals(size_ < 1 ? 0 : new SmartPointerType*[size_])
00257  {
00258   if(internals)
00259   {
00260    copy.incrementInternals();
00261    memcpy(internals, copy.internals, size_ * sizeof(SmartPointerType*));
00262   }
00263  }
00264  
00265  SmartPointerArrayContainer& operator= (SmartPointerArrayContainer const& other) throw()
00266  {
00267   if (this != &other)
00268   {  
00269    other.incrementInternals();
00270    decrementInternals();
00271    
00272    if(size_ < other.size_)
00273    {
00274     if(internals != 0) 
00275      delete [] internals;
00276     
00277     internals = new SmartPointerType*[other.size_];
00278    }
00279    
00280    size_ = other.size_;
00281    
00282    memcpy(internals, other.internals, size_ * sizeof(SmartPointerType*));
00283   }
00284   
00285   return *this;  
00286  }
00287  
00288  bool operator== (SmartPointerArrayContainer const& other) const throw()
00289  {
00290   if(size_ != other.size_) return false;
00291   if(size_ == 0) return true;

00293   for(int i = 0; i < size_; i++)

00295    if(internals[i] != other.internals[i])
00296     return false;
00297   }
00298   
00299   return true;
00300  }
00301  
00302  bool operator!= (SmartPointerArrayContainer const& other) const throw()
00303  {
00304   return !operator==(other);
